title: Mumbai, Maharashtra — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Mumbai, Maharashtra: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Mumbai is a city in Maharashtra with a population of 20,961,000. India’s financial capital and largest city, home to Bollywood, the Bombay Stock Exchange, and a vibrant coastal urban culture. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
